data.reflection:
Good game! GPT-5-nano won with 20 HP remaining.

Quick recap and thoughts:
- Early midgame (HP ~60): Attacking to maintain pressure was reasonable; holding potions until sub-50 is generally good.
- At 40 HP: Using a potion was correct to avoid immediate 2-turn lethal.
- After both potions were used, we were behind on the damage race and had no safe lines left—attacking to force a mistake was the only play.

Overall, your lines were consistent with maximizing survival while pressuring. In fixed-damage mirrors, being the first to need a potion often cedes tempo; the key edge usually comes from timing a potion to deny the opponent a clean two-hit window.
